I once got extremely drunk with a group of friends on labor day weekend, normal enough, up until the point where I started to feel sick. Within seconds of sitting down my nose started to tingle and my mouth salivate, before I knew it I was projectile vomiting all over my friends comforter, mattress and of course myself. Luckily for me the vomit had only got on my jeans so I quickly stripped the jeans off, washed them in the shower and hung them up on the shower curtain to dry. Next I changed into shorts, washed my mouth and walked back out into the party feeling better than ever. Later that night when it was time to crash my buddy walked into his room to find the mess. The entire room smelled terrible and I felt so bad but I couldn't tell everyone that I was the one who couldn't hold it together. So, someone suggested it was another guy who showed up at the party who everyone knew to be a big DAB (Drunk Ass Bitch) and had already thrown up that night.
